newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia producer price index up 1.7 pct in April.
newsitem.headline: Colombia producer price index up 1.7 pct in April.

text.p: BOGOTA, May 2 Reuter - Colombia's producer price index rose 1.7 percent in April compared to 0.9 percent in the same month last year, the central bank said in a statement Friday.
The cumulative rise in the PPI in the first four months of the year was 8.5 percent and 14.9 percent over the last 12 months, the statement said.
The index for goods produced and consumed in Colombia was up 1.9 percent, while that for goods produced abroad was unchanged, the central bank said.
The index was driven up largely by a 10.7 percent rise in the cost of coffee, a 3.3 percent gain in the cost of beef and pork and a 1.02 percent rise in the cost of manufactured goods.
The cumulative rise in the PPI in the first four months of 1996 was 8.1 percent.
